TITLE: Korean Honorifics in K-Dramas and the Texture of Friendship

Have you ever watched a K-drama and sensed that a single word — just one syllable, really — shifted the entire relationship between two characters?

Sabina's Story

✈️ On a Hong Kong-Seoul red-eye, somewhere around 2 a.m., a Canadian passenger leaned across the aisle and asked me something I still think about. He had been watching a drama on his tablet the whole flight. "Why," he said, "do Korean men call each other 'older brother' when they clearly aren't related?"

Hi, I'm Sabina. During my 23 years working as a flight attendant, I answered thousands of questions about Korea at 35,000 feet. That particular question, though, settled somewhere deeper.
